concept: Context in a small pane at level 4 next to its trigger, the top of the stack, without dimming the screen.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a white tooltip-like box with an arrow and a grey border (Bootstrap popover)
default_to_avoid.why_not: an arrowed white box owns a colour and a border and ignores the stack

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a level-4 pane, the lightest and highest, next to its trigger with no scrim

derivation.consequence: panes enter by rising a short distance and settling, as an object placed in space would
derivation.form: it grows a little from its trigger and settles

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: Esc and a press outside close it and focus returns to the trigger

variants.reason: A is the top of the measured stack (D-025); its position says where it came from without an arrow. B adds a border and an arrow the glass does not need. C pushes the layout down.

popover.why: a level-4 pane next to its trigger, narrow enough for a sentence and a few controls

title.why: a short title in the emphasis size, the same in every theme and on every scene

previewWrap.why: in a preview the trigger and the open popover sit one under the other

preview.why: drawn in place for documentation, without its entry animation

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring on the pane or control so a keyboard user sees where they are

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours draw an outline so the overlay keeps its edge without the glass

@pop.why: it grows a little from its trigger and settles, zero under reduced motion
